CFB-week.summary: Only one game in the window: Ole Miss at Oklahoma, moved to Sunday Nov 15 (1 PM ET per Dimers/Fox; an older 247 preview still lists Saturday), with Oklahoma a 2.5-point favorite and a total near 49. Ole Miss is without RB Kewan Lacy (dislocated shoulder, third straight missed game) and starting RG Patrick Kutas; Oklahoma has Jason Witten calling plays and may get OL Ryan Fodje back. Posted player props were thin: six yardage lines found, mostly FanDuel receiving yards.

NBA-HOU-at-WSH-1116.summary: Alex Sarr is questionable with an illness after a 44-minute, 30-point double-overtime game against Detroit on Nov 13. Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee management), Clint Capela (ankle) and the suspended Marcus Smart, and Washington has Tre Johnson (back) and Bub Carrington (chest) questionable.

NBA-IND-at-PHI-1115.summary: Philadelphia is without Joel Embiid (right foot management), Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back), so the frontcourt is short and Jabari Walker is listed to start at center. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton and Ben Sheppard, with Andrew Nembhard (hip) and Aaron Nesmith (hand) questionable.

NBA-SA-at-UTAH-1115.summary: San Antonio is healthy except for Tobias Harris and Jayden Quaintance, and keeps its Fox-Harper-Castle-Vassell-Wembanyama starting group. Utah is without Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Nurkic, with Hayes out or day-to-day, which leaves it short in the frontcourt. I found no official same-day NBA injury report, so this rests on an injury-feed aggregator.

NFL-BUF-at-NYJ-1115.summary: Garrett Wilson (concussion) and Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) were full on Friday and are questionable, so the Jets expect their receivers mostly back. That squeezes Mason Taylor, who had 2 targets last week behind Kenyon Sadiq. Buffalo is likely without RT Spencer Brown; Jets LB Trevin Wallace is out.

NFL-CAR-at-NO-1115.summary: New Orleans is without starting C Erik McCoy and RT Taliese Fuaga. Travis Etienne returns from IR as questionable, sharing the backfield with Kamara while CJ Donaldson is out. Carolina loses ILB Bobby Okereke; Jaelan Phillips and Xavier Legette (just off IR) practiced fully Friday and are questionable.

NFL-HOU-at-CLE-1115.summary: Houston is without David Montgomery (groin, downgraded to out), so Woody Marks leads the backfield, and without Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring); Xavier Hutchinson and Tank Dell are the WR2 and WR3 behind Nico Collins, and Dell has been cleared. Houston's defense also loses Danielle Hunter and Azeez Al-Shaair.

NFL-JAX-at-TEN-1115.summary: Jacksonville (6-2) is a 10-point road favorite with a ~28.5 implied total against 1-7 Tennessee; Tuten is a full go after a limited week, while new acquisitions Jessie Bates and Jordan Davis sit. Tennessee is without WR Carnell Tate (Ayomanor moves up), DT Jeffery Simmons and LBs Barton and Hill, and Tyjae Spears returns from a knee injury after a full Friday practice.

NFL-LA-at-ARI-1115.summary: The Rams play without Puka Nacua (knee sprain and turf toe, headed to IR), Davante Adams (hamstring) and LG Steve Avila, leaving Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell and Tyler Higbee as Stafford's main targets and Kyren Williams as a bigger receiving option. Arizona starts rookie Carson Beck in his NFL debut after Gardner Minshew went to IR with a season-ending elbow injury, and it's missing center Hjalte Froholdt (concussion).

NFL-LAC-at-BAL-1117.summary: Ladd McConkey (back) missed all three practices and is questionable, Brenen Thompson is doubtful and G Branson Taylor is out, so the Chargers' passing game may lean on Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris and KeAndre Lambert-Smith. Baltimore starts newly acquired Jacoby Brissett with Lamar Jackson out 6-10 weeks (thumb), replacing Joe Fagnano; the total is a low 38.5.

NFL-MIN-at-GB-1115.summary: Minnesota is thin: Kirk Cousins starts at QB (Kyler Murray out, Carson Wentz the backup), and TE T.J. Hockenson and WR Jauan Jennings are out with Jordan Addison questionable (thumb), so Justin Jefferson's target share should grow. Green Bay plays without Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) and Micah Parsons; MarShawn Lloyd is listed as the starting RB while Chris Brooks returns from IR, so the backfield split is unsettled.

NFL-PIT-at-CIN-1116.summary: Sunday night AFC North game with Cincinnati a 3.5-point home favorite; Pittsburgh's WR group stays thin (Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson remain on IR) and TE Pat Freiermuth was added Saturday as questionable with an illness. Cincinnati is without S Kyle Dugger, WR Andrei Iosivas is doubtful, and the forecast calls for rain in the low 40s.

NFL-SEA-at-LV-1115.summary: Drew Lock starts for Seattle with Darnold out, but was limited all week (right elbow, new oblique) and the line is without LT Charles Cross and G Quenton Nelson. Las Vegas starts No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza for the first time after Kirk Cousins was traded, facing the league's top-ranked defense; the Raiders' run defense ranks last (151 yards per game allowed).

NFL-SF-at-DAL-1115.summary: Dallas is without TE Jake Ferguson, RB Tyler Goodson, WR Jonathan Mingo and S PJ Locke. George Pickens returns from a hamstring injury with no designation after limited practices. San Francisco is still without Mike Evans and Brandon Aiyuk; Deebo Samuel returns, and newly traded Keenan Allen debuts.

SOCCER-day.summary: No listed player is ruled out. Perisic is back from a ban but left out of the predicted Croatia XI, and Tierney is projected at centre-back in a back three. Granada are on a six-match winning run at home with a near-full squad, which hurts the Granada under 0.5 bet.

NBA-DET-at-MIA-1115.summary: No current report for Saturday could be found: search results were from earlier seasons, so Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) remain unconfirmed after missing Friday. Detroit is still without Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe per the packet.
